hero.title: Work Type Configuration
hero.description: Review published Work Types, prepare controlled drafts, and publish versioned rules without changing existing Work history.

states.noWorkTypesDescription: There are no Work Types available in this office for the current filter.
states.selectWorkTypeDescription: Choose a Work Type from the list to review its published version, draft, and history.

detail.noDescription: No description has been recorded for this Work Type.

configuration.title: Ownership, creators, closure and SLA
configuration.description: These rules are stored in this draft version and become immutable after publication.
configuration.creatorAccountsDescription: Select only accounts that are allowed to create this Work Type directly.

fields.title: Work fields
fields.description: Configure the controlled data fields used by this Work Type version.
fields.emptyDescription: Add only the fields required by this Work Type.
fields.label: Label
fields.optionsPlaceholder: Option A, Option B, Option C

stages.title: Workflow stages
stages.description: Define responsibility and assignment rules. Runtime Work stages are created later from the published version.
stages.emptyDescription: A publishable Work Type needs at least one required stage.
stages.name: Stage name

dependencies.title: Stage dependencies
dependencies.description: Use dependencies only when a stage must wait for another stage to finish.
dependencies.none: No dependencies configured. Stages may proceed in parallel when their activation rules allow it.

release.title: Draft release
release.publishDescription: Save the draft configuration before publishing. Publishing retires the previous published version and keeps its history intact.
release.draftOnlyDescription: You can prepare this draft, but only the Office Head can publish the final version.
release.confirmPublishDescription: This makes the draft the published version for future Work. Existing Work remains linked to its original version.
release.confirmDiscardDescription: This removes the current draft only. Published and retired versions remain unchanged.

readonly.title: Read-only Work Type oversight
readonly.description: You can review published rules and version history. Draft, edit, discard, and publish actions are not available for your account.

history.title: Version history
history.description: Published and retired versions remain readable so historical Work keeps its original meaning.
